subject: Sorry about the hallway bike
text:
Hi,

Sorry for the mix-up about the shared storage space. I misunderstood the notice and left my bike outside before the snow arrived. I moved it this morning, so nothing is blocking the hall now.

Your flight delay made the timing worse, and I should have waited before mentioning it. If you still have any items in the hall, I can help move them before your return, without more hassle.

No need to reply now.
